Shiba Swap is a decentralized exchange, which means it operates without a central intermediary. Shiba Swap is a fork of the SushiSwap codebase. Shiba Swap runs on the Ethereum blockchain as a smart-contract application.

Sushi Swap is a decentralized exchange, which means it operates without a central intermediary. Sushi Swap was derived from the Uniswap design, with additional features. Sushi Swap runs on public blockchains as a smart-contract application. Sushi Swap uses the SUSHI token for governance.

Bone is an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain. Bone is associated with the Shiba Swap ecosystem. Bone is a fungible token rather than a non-fungible one.
